Substantive vuln: CVE-2026-39919 heap buffer overflow in Ghostscript 9.21-10.07.1, unauthenticated RCE via crafted PDF/JPEG 2000, found by Wordfence Argus, affects WordPress/Imagick and any Ghostscript deployment.

CVE-2026-39919.evidence: Wordfence built two working PoC exploits (writes 1,024 bytes into a 256-byte buffer) and tested 10 Linux distros plus the WordPress Docker image; no in-the-wild exploitation reported.

decisions.reason: Real breach claim: ByteToBreach says it exfiltrated 80M+ patient records from Ampath Laboratories, a major SA pathology provider; attacker has history of African targets.
